digest: Nvidia faces major corporate and political fallout after CEO Jensen Huang resigned amid a scandal and the stock experienced a historic losing streak.
A nationwide FAA ground stop caused widespread flight disruptions and cancellations that are expected to take days to clear.
A Federal Reserve survey identified artificial intelligence risks as the biggest threat to the financial system.
Global oil supplies are projected to exceed demand for the first time since February, though diesel prices may not immediately drop.
Financial institutions like Goldman Sachs are positioning themselves around potential upcoming deals, including Anthropic's expected IPO.
